name: My Spring With You
source:
After almost a decade apart, two old friends are at last reunited. Will their feelings for each other finally bloom? Or will this be their final goodbye?

[From [url=https://totes-studio-p.itch.io/my-spring-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两位老友阔别近十年后终于重聚。他们的感情最终能否开花结果？或者这将是他们最后的告别？

[来自[url=https://totes-studio-p.itch.io/my-spring-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
